correctness.rationale: For prescribed hub correlations x_i, subtract the hub component and normalize the residual vectors. The edge residual correlations can be chosen independently in [−1,1]: root the tree and construct a new child residual using its parent and a fresh perpendicular vector. A zero residual at x_i=±1 simply forces incident edge correlations to x_i x_j; choose any auxiliary unit residual vector there. Each of the n−1 edge widths is 2 sqrt((1−x_i²)(1−x_j²)). Fubini groups the powers as d_i/2, and rescaling all 2n−1 coordinates multiplies by 2^{−(2n−1)}, leaving 2^{−n} times the J product. Strict Hölder gives strict convexity of log J_d. Nonnegative excess degrees sum to n−2; their sorted vector lies between the 0/1 vector with n−2 ones and the concentrated vector, in the majorization order. Strict equality yields only path or star. The sample n=4 and n=5 values and the constant in the ratio follow by J_1=π/2, J_2=4/3 and J_{n−1}~sqrt(2π/n). At n=2,3 the two trees coincide up to isomorphism.
residual_risks: The filed Prüfer, quadrature and Gram-test output is recorded, not presented as a fresh replay. The constructive and majorization proofs establish the infinite claims independently.
No fixed-rank or cyclic-residual extension is part of the result.
